metadata.description: Machine-readable proposed RBAC permission matrix grounded in the actual Pulsiv.dev frontend (pulsiv_fe) and backend (pulse) repositories. Defines 4 core hierarchical customer roles, 2 additive permission bundles, 1 internal platform role, project-scoped access overrides, legacy DB enum migration mappings, the centralized permission registry, and page/action-to-permission mappings.

scopes.description: Unauthenticated public routes (login, signup, password reset, invite preview, SDK telemetry ingestion with API key).
Authenticated user's personal profile, security credentials (password, MFA, passkeys, sessions), and personal notification preferences.
Tenant-wide resources owned by an organization (team members, invitations, domains, SSO, SCIM, org settings, billing, audit logs, org-wide alerting/automation/AI/observability).
Project-scoped resources within an organization (project settings, environments, API keys, remote SDK config, project alert rules/channels/routes/DLQ, error groups, telemetry).

Internal Pulsiv.dev SaaS operator administration (managing global billing plan catalog, approving organization quota increase requests, platform-wide user/system ops). Strictly isolated from customer organization roles.

owner.label: Organization Owner
owner.description: Full administrative and financial control over the organization, including destructive lifecycle actions, ownership transfer, enterprise identity (SSO/SCIM), and billing management.

admin.label: Organization Admin
admin.description: Operational and technical administrator across all organization projects, members (up to admin), domains, integrations, alert policies, automation workflows, and SDK configurations. Excludes billing mutations and destructive org ownership actions unless granted billing_manager.

member.label: Organization Member
member.description: Standard engineering/developer role. Can view all accessible projects and telemetry, triage error groups, respond to incidents, silence noisy alerts, execute automation runs, use AI investigation tools, and draft SDK remote configurations.

viewer.label: Organization Viewer
viewer.description: Strictly read-only access to organization profile, accessible projects, dashboards, observability telemetry (logs, metrics, traces, errors, replays, profiling, crons), alert rules, incidents, and automation runs. Cannot mutate any tenant state or trigger paid AI generations.

billing_manager.label: Billing Manager
billing_manager.description: Additive permission bundle granting full visibility and management of subscriptions, plans, payment methods, invoices, billing alerts, and quota increase requests without granting engineering or project admin privileges.

incident_responder.label: Incident Responder (On-Call)
incident_responder.description: Additive permission bundle for on-call operators and NOC engineers. Enables acknowledging/resolving incidents, managing alert silences, triaging errors, executing/approving remediation workflows, retrying alert DLQs, and running AI root-cause investigations.

platform_admin.label: Internal Platform Administrator
platform_admin.description: Internal Pulsiv.dev SaaS operator role. Strictly separated from customer organization roles; cannot be assigned via organization member management or SCIM.

legacyRoleMigrationMap.description: Mapping from current PostgreSQL org_role ENUM ('owner', 'admin', 'developer', 'security', 'billing', 'member', 'viewer') to the proposed 4 core roles + 2 permission bundles.

admin.notes: Direct 1:1 mapping. Does not include billing_manager by default unless explicitly granted.

developer.notes: Consolidated into 'member' core role with 'incident_responder' bundle to preserve existing on-call/error-triage capabilities.

security.notes: Mapped to 'admin' (or 'member' + audit/compliance read if fine-grained custom roles are later introduced) because all security/compliance/SSO/audit endpoints require admin-tier access.

billing.notes: Eliminates the linear hierarchy flaw where 'billing' (rank 50) had higher privileges than 'member' (rank 40) on engineering resources. Maps to read-only 'viewer' + 'billing_manager' bundle.

owner.notes: Consolidated with project admin; organization ownership remains at org level.

admin.notes: Can manage project settings, environments, API keys, remote config, and project alert rules.

qa.notes: Consolidated into project_member (fixes rank inconsistency between base.service.ts and settings.service.ts).

projectAccessModel.description: Resolution rules combining organization_members and project_members to eliminate split-brain authorization.
rules: 1. Active Organization Membership Prerequisite: A user MUST have status = 'active' in organization_members for the project's parent organizationId. If organization_members status is not 'active', all project access is immediately denied regardless of project_members rows.

2. Org Owner & Org Admin Implicit Access: Users with org coreRole in ('owner', 'admin') automatically receive effective 'project_admin' privileges on ALL projects within their organization without requiring an explicit row in project_members.

3. Default Org Member Visibility: For standard projects, org 'member' and 'viewer' inherit their respective role ('project_member' or 'project_viewer') unless overridden by an explicit row in project_members.

4. Project-Level Role Override: An explicit row in project_members can elevate an org 'member' to 'project_admin' for a specific project, or restrict a user to 'project_viewer' on a sensitive project.

5. Cascading Revocation: Removing or suspending a user in organization_members MUST atomically revoke their active sessions for that org and delete/deactivate their project_members records across all projects in that organization.
